# `concat_ws`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the concatenation of the strings separated by `sep`, skipping null values.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
concat_ws(sep[, str | array(str)]+)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | > 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- concat_ws, example 1
> SELECT concat_ws(' ', 'Spark', 'SQL');
Spark SQL
```

```sql
-- concat_ws, example 2
> SELECT concat_ws('s');

```

```sql
-- concat_ws, example 3
> SELECT concat_ws('/', 'foo', null, 'bar');
foo/bar
```

```sql
-- concat_ws, example 4
> SELECT concat_ws(null, 'Spark', 'SQL');
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
